name: An Adjacent Degree-Four Corner Repairs a Rooted Endpoint
definition: Take the certified 289-concept factor $B$ rooted at $29$ and adjoin vertex $157$. The addition acquires support $\{1,2,7,8\}$, of bitmask $390$.
parameters: The extension has 290 concepts in the stored twelve-coordinate embedding.
properties: Both root $29$ and the new vertex $157$ are corners of the completed four-cube and are adjacent in coordinate $7$. The extension peels to either vertex, while deleting $157$ returns $B$, which cannot peel to $29$. Thus deletion of an adjacent nonroot corner can destroy a prescribed endpoint; support size four is sufficient.
